items.label: 1783年
items.title: 欧拉在计算中度过最后一天
items.text: 在圣彼得堡，欧拉照常给孙辈上数学课，用粉笔演算气球的运动，又和同事讨论刚发现的天王星。傍晚他突发脑溢血，当晚辞世；此后圣彼得堡科学院又陆续整理出版了他大量遗稿。

sources.fact_quote: On 18 September 1783 Euler spent the first half of the day as usual. He gave a mathematics lesson to one of his grandchildren, did some calculations with chalk on two boards on the motion of balloons

items.label: 1819年
items.title: 傅科出生：用摆演示地球自转
items.text: 莱昂·傅科生于巴黎。他让一个能在任意方向自由摆动的摆保持摆面不变，地面则随地球转动，观众因此能亲眼看到摆面偏转；他还造出陀螺仪，并用旋转镜改进了光速测定。

sources.fact_quote: In January 1851 he succeeded in constructing such a pendulum in the basement of his house. It did indeed retain its position in space, demonstrating clearly for the first time that the Earth rotates.

items.label: 1907年
items.title: 麦克米伦出生：铀之后的新元素
items.text: 埃德温·麦克米伦生于加州雷东多比奇。诺贝尔奖官网写道，他1940年用加速器让中子轰击铀，得到了原子序数93的元素并命名为镎；他后来改进回旋加速器，为同步加速器的出现铺路。

sources.date_quote: Born: 18 September 1907, Redondo Beach, CA, USA
sources.fact_quote: In 1940 Edwin McMillan used a particle accelerator to radiate uranium with neutrons and proved that an element with an atomic number of 93 had been created. It was named neptunium.

items.label: 1926年
items.title: 迈阿密飓风在清晨登陆
items.text: 美国国家气象局记录，一场四级飓风在清晨从迈阿密以南的帕尔梅托湾附近登陆，飓风强度大风向外延伸约一百英里，风暴潮把海水推入城区；当时的预报与警报手段有限，灾后当地逐步改进预警体系。

sources.date_quote: September 18, 2026, marks the 100th anniversary of the 1926 Great Miami Hurricane
sources.fact_quote: In the early morning hours of September 18, the large Category 4 hurricane is estimated to have made landfall near Palmetto Bay, about 10 miles south of downtown Miami

items.label: 1959年
items.title: 先锋3号升空测量地球磁场
items.text: 先锋3号由先锋号火箭从卡纳维拉尔角送入轨道，星上装着质子磁力仪、X射线电离室和微流星探测器，用来测量地球磁场、太阳X射线和近地尘埃环境；这次发射也为“先锋”系列的发射活动画上句号。

sources.fact_quote: This vehicle incorporated the Allegheny Ballistics Laboratory X248 A2 solid-propellant motor as the 3d stage in place of the Grand Central motor used in previous Vanguard vehicles.

items.label: 1980年
items.title: 联盟38号送古巴宇航员上天
items.text: 古巴飞行员塔马约·门德斯与苏联宇航员罗曼年科乘联盟38号升空，随后与礼炮6号对接，在轨飞行近八天。他穿特制鞋具参加前庭适应实验，还参与蔗糖结晶实验，为古巴制糖业寻找工艺线索。

sources.date_quote: The Joint Cuban–Soviet mission launched on 18 September 1980, and concluded on 26 September
sources.fact_quote: In September 1980, Tamayo blasted off aboard Soyuz 38 alongside Soviet commander Yuri Romanenko, embarking on a historic seven-day mission
